  3. Tender calendars

Interested eligible suppliers are encouraged to submit:

  • Covering letter expressing their interest in accordance with requirements in each bid plan
  • Relevant information about their company (company profile).

Companies interested in participating in any of the listed bidding exercises should be registered with the United Nations Global Marketplace, where instructions on how to register can be found.

UNICEF strives to uphold the rights of every child, protecting them from harm and all forms of discrimination, so that they can grow up healthy and educated to reach their full potential. This work is in line with UNICEF’s globally recognized mandate and its support of national priorities.
